_note: What the owner needs to do or decide. The Dhanya progress panel reads this file. Claude keeps it up to date. status is 'open' or 'done'. 'when' says what it blocks. Never put secrets here.

items.title: Restart VS Code (done) and keep Docker updated (done)
items.why: Loads the new connectors, agents and the Karpathy skill
items.how: Close VS Code and reopen it on the workspace folder, then click Allow when asked about connectors
items.when: When Claude says the current work is finished

items.title: Brevo sending key (saved and tested)
items.why: The app needs it to send sign-up and password emails. The connector token can't do that
items.how: Brevo: Account, SMTP & API, API Keys, Generate a new API key (leave the MCP box unticked). Paste it after BREVO_API_KEY= in the secrets file

items.title: Pricing questions answered (Claude picked the defaults, recorded in decisions.md)
items.why: The pricing review raised questions, such as whether the 10,000-bag limit is per line or per order
items.how: Read the S3.2 section in sandbox/docs/plan/decisions.md and tell Claude your answers

items.title: Transport range measured by total bags (confirmed)
items.why: The plan assumes total bags (free from 10 to 100 bags, otherwise a fee). Orders and the mill settings screen depend on it
items.how: Reply yes, or say if you meant order value or distance

items.title: GST and invoices: build a normal invoice now, full GST and accountant later (decided)
items.why: Tax rate on rice by bag size (including bags above 25 kg), tax invoice or bill of supply, e-invoice rules above 5 crore turnover, and how long to keep records
items.how: Take the D-08 questions from sandbox/docs/plan/00-START-HERE.md to your accountant and send Claude the answers

items.title: Telugu checker (deferred to a later phase by the owner)
items.why: Claude drafts the Telugu text but can't judge it. A native reader must check it, and the PDF letter shapes too
items.how: Name a person, or say you will do it. Drafts are listed in messages/te.review.md

items.title: Hosting: stay on the free plan for now (decided; revisit when the idea works out)
items.why: Vercel's free plan is for personal, non-commercial use. Real mills taking real orders may break its terms
items.how: Choose: pay about US$20 a month for Vercel Pro, or move to another host. Claude can compare options
items.when: Before the first real mill (story S11.2)

items.title: GitHub tokens: keep using them for now (decided)
items.why: Two tokens were pasted into chat and the release pipeline uses a broad copy. They should be narrow and fresh
items.how: Delete both old tokens on GitHub, then create one fine-grained token for the Dhanya repo only (steps in sandbox/docs/runbooks/accounts.md)

items.title: Free web address chosen: dhanyamart1.vercel.app (attached to the production project)
items.why: Real domains cost money. A free address from Vercel ends in .vercel.app. dhanya.vercel.app is already taken
items.how: Choose one, for example dhanyamart.vercel.app, and tell Claude. Claude will attach it to the production project

items.title: Staging site seen: the Dhanya page works
items.why: Nobody has judged the look yet. Automated checks can't tell you if it feels right
items.how: Open https://dhanya-staging.vercel.app on your phone and follow the short guide Claude gave in chat

items.title: Telugu badge size (deferred with Telugu)
items.why: Claude made Telugu captions and badges 10 percent larger, because they were too small. It is a default you may change
items.how: Open the component gallery with ?lang=te on your phone and tell Claude if the small labels are easy to read

items.title: Try the mill sign-up on staging with your trial code
items.why: Proves sign-up, the email and sign-in work end to end
items.how: Open dhanya-staging.vercel.app/sign-up, use the access code Claude gave you in chat, confirm the email, sign in, open /mill/orders. Tell Claude what you see

items.title: Run the autosave installer once (optional)
items.why: Saves all work to GitHub every 20 minutes even when Claude is out of usage

items.title: Backups: choose a key and switch them on (when ready)
items.why: Encrypted nightly database backup (story S0.8). Off until you do this
items.how: Pick a key of 16+ characters and keep a copy in your password manager. In GitHub (Dhanya-sandbox, Settings, Secrets) add BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY and BACKUP_DATABASE_URL, and the variable BACKUP_ENABLED=true. Optionally UPTIME_ENABLED=true

items.title: Answer the small product questions from S2.2, S2.3, S2.8
items.why: Claude picked safe defaults; your answers can change them
items.how: Read the owner-question lists in sandbox/docs/plan/decisions.md (S2.2, S2.3, S2.8): one login per business, one or several owners, access-code lifetime, failed sign-ins in the log, how long to keep audit rows

items.title: Real-phone checks (later)
items.why: Install-to-home-screen, keyboard, notches and slow networks cannot be fully tested by Claude
items.how: When the shop and mill screens are ready, open the staging link on your phone and tell Claude what looks wrong
